citation.authors: Kelly MR, Yuen F, Satterfield BC, et al.
citation.title: Endogenous Diurnal Patterns of Adrenal and Gonadal Hormones During a 24-Hour Constant Routine After Simulated Shift Work

reported.what: cortisol mesor (24 h mean abundance) in the constant routine after 3 days of simulated day shift, mean +/- SE, pg/mL, n=7 (sex-adjusted cosinor estimate)

location.where: Table 2, Cortisol row, Mesor +/- SE (pg/mL), day-shift column

reported.what: cortisol cosinor amplitude and acrophase by prior shift condition (Table 2)
night-minus-day difference in cortisol mesor, printed in the text in ug/dL without an uncertainty

location.quote: Night-shift work marginally increased the mesor of the major glucocorticoid cortisol, by 1 μg/dL

detail: The constant routine's hourly isocaloric snacks (and the shift-day meals) are given without any energy or macronutrient amount, so no protocol can be written without assuming a meal; in addition every cortisol number is a sex-adjusted cosinor estimate in pg/mL, a unit the loader does not accept, with amplitude and acrophase being cosinor parameters the statistics do not cover.
